description: This file defines the Twig EscaperExtension class which adds escaping functionalities to Twig templating engine. It provides methods to register escape filters, node visitors, token parsers, and manages escaping strategies.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\EscaperExtension
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractExtension, providing escape filtering and strategy management for Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the extension with a default escaping strategy, typically 'html'.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns an array with AutoEscapeTokenParser used for auto-escaping in templates.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Provides node visitors, specifically the EscaperNodeVisitor, for processing AST nodes.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Defines and returns the escape, e (alias), and raw filters for template use.

methods.name: setEnvironment
methods.description: Deprecated method to set the Twig environment; also caches the EscaperRuntime.

methods.name: setEscaperRuntime
methods.description: Deprecated method to set a custom EscaperRuntime instance.

methods.name: setDefaultStrategy
methods.description: Sets the default escaping strategy, which can be a string or a callable.

methods.name: getDefaultStrategy
methods.description: Returns the default escaping strategy for a given template name.

methods.name: setEscaper
methods.description: Deprecated method to define a new escaper callable for a specific strategy.

methods.name: getEscapers
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve all defined escapers.

methods.name: setSafeClasses
methods.description: Deprecated method to specify safe classes for escaping.

methods.name: addSafeClass
methods.description: Deprecated method to add a safe class with associated strategies.

methods.name: escapeFilterIsSafe
methods.description: Static method to determine if a filter argument is safe, returning the safe contexts.
